notes: Dev templates for scripts/interpreter_corpus.py generate. One spec-shaped object per language in `sets` ({v, lang, templates}). `{name}` in text names a value pool of that language in values-dev.json; the same name twice is the same value. gold follows spec 1.7: slots map to lists of accepted spans (with {name} refs, ints pools use the value's `gold`), `time` lists {pool} names whose chosen value resolves to a local ISO time; present iff a time slot is filled. `op` is the gold op, the refused op for a refuse template, else null; `channel` defaults to messaging. Fictional content only.
